frank: onboarding nebula-lite-6b (llama->qwen hybrid). int8 generation looks fine until accented characters or enumerated lists show up, then it derails. anyone seen this pattern?
sara: could be tokenizer normalization + kv-cache alignment. which normalizer did you use?
frank: we used our default NFKC fallback. upstream repo states NFC and has a small patch: preserve_combining=true.
guto: that will change how characters like "é" are represented (composed vs decomposed). token boundary diff -> kv positions off -> garbage later. also check special token IDs (bos/eos) and whether converter emitted a kv_pos_offset.
frank: sample:```
# prompt: summarize bullets
FP32: "Results: (1) latency down 7%. (2) accuracy stable."
INT8: "Results: (1) latency down.
Random product copy about pricing."
```
eval-bot: baseline(fp32): rouge-l 0.47 | factuality 0.93
int8(before): rouge-l 0.29 | factuality 0.61
sara: try switching to upstream tokenizer config (NFC + preserve_combining) and re-run conversion. also in convert.py add kv_pos_offset += 1 if model_config.consumes_bos. small off-by-one fixes many issues.
guto: quant note: int8 sometimes amplifies rotary/headwise scale mismatch. try per-channel quant + rotary_scale_tweak=0.9-0.95. we had a similar fix last month.
frank: swapped to upstream tokenizer + kv_pos_offset=+1 + per-channel int8 + rotary_scale_tweak=0.92 and re-evaluated.
eval-bot: int8(after): rouge-l 0.45 | factuality 0.90
sara: awesome. please add two onboarding checks: 1) token_fingerprint (first 128 tokens) must match upstream within 2%, 2) newline/bullet smoke (20 prompts) must not regress >5% on factuality.
frank: will open PR with tests, conversion note, and a short checklist: use upstream tokenizer, assert special ids match, sanity-run rotary_scale tuning, set kv_pos_offset when bos consumed. linking this thread in issue #4367. thanks all :tada:
